title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: Rules and conditions for using the APPAM administration platform for authorized users.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using the APPAM platform, you agree to comply with all operational guidelines established for metropolitan public witnessing.

accounts.title: 2. User Accounts & Credentials
accounts.content: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their credentials. Account sharing or unauthorized access to third parties is strictly prohibited.

conduct.title: 3. Acceptable Use & Confidentiality
conduct.content: Information stored within the system, including volunteer records and site locations, is strictly confidential and must not be shared externally.

modifications.title: 4. Service Modifications
modifications.content: We reserve the right to update the platform and terms as needed to enhance security, compliance, and coordination efficiency.
